task: You are hungry! Let's cook a delicious meal. Check the cookbook in the kitchen for the recipe. Once done, enjoy your meal!
description:
Ah, the kitchen. This is some kind of kitchen, really great usual vibes in this place, a wonderful usual atmosphere. And now, well, you're in it.

You can see a fridge. You see a closed oven nearby. You lean against the wall, inadvertently pressing a secret button. The wall opens up to reveal a table. On the table you can make out a cookbook. You can make out a counter. You wonder idly who left that here. The counter is vast. On the counter you can make out a knife, so there's that. You bend down to tie your shoe. When you stand up, you notice a stove. The stove is conventional. But the thing is empty. Aw, here you were, all excited for there to be things on it!
